# John Jayasankar

> Lead Product Manager in New York. Production AI agents and 0→1 financial
> infrastructure at Quantile (LSEG), plus independent products shipped end to end.

Every page is static HTML and readable without JavaScript. /simple is the whole
site as one plain page, which is the cheapest thing to read here.

## Pages

- [Work](https://johnjayasankar.com/work): Every system, filterable by kind.
- [Labs](https://johnjayasankar.com/labs): Independent products, built outside the day job.
- [Approach](https://johnjayasankar.com/approach): How autonomy is earned and bounded.
- [About](https://johnjayasankar.com/about): Background, experience and contact.
- [Writing](https://johnjayasankar.com/writing): Short theses on agents, markets and product economics.
- [Simple](https://johnjayasankar.com/simple): The whole site as one plain page.

## Case studies

- [Compression Setup Agent](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/setup-agent): Case study: a production AI agent that cut compression-run setup from 3.5 hours to 8 minutes and tripled run volume at constant headcount.
- [Incident Triage Agent](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/incident-agent): Case study: an MCP-backed incident triage agent that cut expert investigation from 4.5 hours to 11 minutes and escalations to engineering by 78%.
- [Cross-Currency Compression](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/cross-currency): Case study: a 0→1 launch of multilateral cross-currency compression across 12 currency pairs, with 34% more notional reduction per run for 18 banks.
- [Dual-Source Valuation](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/valuation): Case study: dual-source valuation that surfaced discrepancies 48 hours earlier and cut failed-run resubmissions 91% across 24 banks.
- [FX & NDF Compression](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/fx-compression): Case study: FX forward and NDF compression with clearing-house margin inside the optimizer, reaching 100% proposal acceptance across 40+ live runs.
- [Agent Platform & Controls](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/platform): Case study: one human-supervised control pattern across five enterprise agent systems, with MCP servers, typed actions, approval gates, and evals.
- [Pre-Trade Margin Simulator](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/margin-simulator): Case study: a 0→1 pre-trade margin simulator at OpenGamma that compared a trade’s initial margin across venues before execution.
- [RideLens](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/ridelens): Every ride, one comparison. Uber, Lyft, Empower, and Curb ranked before you book.
- [Daylight](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/daylight): Adaptive display lighting for macOS: warmth and brightness on a schedule you set, offline and explainable.
- [RailDrop](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/raildrop): Know when your train gets cheaper. RailDrop watches listed Amtrak fares across your travel window and never invents a price.
- [Gridiron](https://johnjayasankar.com/work/gridiron): Every game. Every drive. One view. A live NFL and college football command center with a 3D field for every game and odds from named sources.
